questions.question:

All letters are mails.

All schedules are mails.

(I) Some letters are schedules.

(II) Some mails are schedules.
questions.solution:

(I) Some letters are schedules. - False (As their is no relation between letters and schedules. Some letters and schedules may be possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II) Some mails are schedules. - True (All schedules are mails. Some Schedule are mails and Some mails are schedules True).

Only conclusion (II) follows

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**

Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2040eaffb074fd42b592cdae119c98b95e1a291a924e7e0c4209b3005a60fec5.png] 

__**57 ÷ 3 **__+ 11 × 7 − 42 = ?

19 + __**11 × 7 **__− 42 = ?

19 + 77 − 42 = ?

96 − 42 = ?

54.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question: Mr. Into ranked 49th from the bottom and 56th from the top in his class. How many students are there in his class?

Mr. Into's rank from the bottom = 49

So, Total students = Rank from top + Rank from bottom - 1.
